findingDetails.title: The opt-in restore still writes through a symlinked ancestor directory
findingDetails.evidence: Phase 011's lstat guard inspects only the final component (:1433-1434). Both baseline write arms then join the repo-relative path and write along it: mkdirSync(dirname(...)) + writeFileSync at :1447-1449 and :1493-1494. A lane that replaces a parent directory of the violated path with a symlink to a directory outside the checkout redirects the write; the link node itself is preserved by the not-in-HEAD branch (:1480-1481). canonicalPath/isSubpath (:616-677) already implement the every-component rule detection uses (:669-677); the write path does not call it.
findingDetails.recommendation: Canonicalize the destination through every component (reuse canonicalPath) and refuse when it leaves the worktree, or refuse any violated path whose parent chain contains a symlink.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read both baseline write arms in full, the not-in-HEAD preservation branch, the quarantine refusal (artifact-side only), and the detection canonicalization for comparison; no git write experiment was run, so the HEAD branch is recorded as unverified rather than claimed.

claimAdjudication.claim: Under opt-in restore, a violated path whose parent directory the lane replaced with a symlink is written through that link, so captured baseline bytes land wherever the link points, possibly outside the repository.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Read the whole revert function for an ancestor canonicalization (none); checked whether the symlink node is removed first (preserved, :1480-1481); checked whether quarantine's refusal covers the repo-side write (artifact-side only); no git checkout experiment (banned for this lineage).
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: The lane must plant the symlink itself and that write is a reported violation; under preserve nothing is written. The damage is reachable only under the restore opt-in, whose post-phase-011 contract is that a restore never writes through a symlink.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade to P2 if a caller canonicalizes join(repoRoot, violation.path) before revertOutOfScopeViolations (none found), or if restore mode is unreachable from the shipped command surface (it is wired through fanout-run.cjs).

findingDetails.title: The restore writer addresses violation paths against a repo root that may be a subdirectory
findingDetails.evidence: resolveContainmentRepoRoot returns cwd unless the artifact tree lives in a different worktree, while git status paths are worktree-root-relative regardless of -C. The write arms join those paths against opts.repoRoot (write-containment.ts:1449, :1494); the deletion pass's disk check correctly uses scope.repoRealRoot (:944). Latent for shipped callers (all dispatch with working_directory: repo_root), re-registered because the remediation put this path on a write surface. Prior F-004, still active.
findingDetails.recommendation: Resolve the guard root to the git toplevel (the helper already has gitToplevel) or assert that cwd is the toplevel before containment runs.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the resolver, its only caller in fanout-run, and both write arms; confirmed the deletion pass uses the resolved scope root while the write arms do not.
